prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ETS', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ETS leads trend tracking (corr=0.211) while ARIMA dominates seasonality capture (corr=0.655), but ONLY_CWT_catboost achieves the lowest overall RMSE (140.82). With high model redundancy (error similarity=0.90) and concept drift detected, STL-hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit the additive decomposition while deduplicating redundant models. The split between trend and seasonality champions justifies mixed weighting across components.
